title: Pintar 1992 lumbar JC failure strain by level

quantity.name: failure strain
quantity.definition: failure deformation / original length (matched geometry cadavers)

source.authors: Pintar FA, Yoganandan N, Myers T, Elhagediab A, Sances A Jr
source.sample: 132 ligament samples from 38 fresh cadavers (mechanics, data of Myklebust et al. 1988); geometry from 8 additional cadavers; human cadaveric lumbar ligaments T12-S1 (ALL, PLL, JC, LF, ISL, SSL), in situ isolation tests to failure
source.age: geometry cadavers 31-80 y (mean 63); mechanics cadavers not reported here

protocol.summary: In situ isolation tensile tests to failure of bone-ligament-bone preparations (Myklebust et al. 1988 protocol; linear ramp displacement; rate not restated in this note). Failure = peak load. Stiffness = slope of least-squares line over the most linear portion of force-deformation curve. Failure stress = failure force / CSA (CSA from cryomicrotome images of 8 separate, anthropometrically matched cadavers); failure strain = failure deformation / original length (Table 1 definitions).
how_to_simulate: Model the joint (facet) capsule as in the FE/MSK model (bone-ligament-bone, original length per Table 1: 16.4 mm mean)
Isolate the ligament (other structures removed) and apply uniaxial elongation along its line of action to failure
Report the requested quantity per level (stiffness = slope of most linear part of force-deformation)

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 re-read from 150-dpi page render (OCR errors corrected: LF L1-L2 stiffness SD 7.8, LF L4-L5 stiffness 27.2+-12.2, ALL L4-L5 energy SD 7.99, SSL L2-L3 energy SD 5.77, ISL L5-S1 energy 0.78). Per-level n not reported (132 samples over 6 ligaments x 6 levels). doi not printed in PDF.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
